params.amount: APX (1e18 = 1 APX) to transfer into the reward pool.

params._apxPerYear: Initial emission: APX tokens per year (in WAD, 1e18 = 1 APX).
params._owner: Contract owner (can add rewards, adjust rate, pause).

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params._apxPerYear: New annual emission in APX WAD (e.g. 1_000_000 ether = 1M APX/year).

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

addRewards(uint256).notice: Fund the rewards pool. Caller must pre-approve this contract to spend APX.

currentApyBps().notice: Current dynamic APY in basis points (10000 = 100%).         Rises when fewer APX are staked, falls when more enter.

earned(address).notice: APX rewards earned by `account` — includes accrued + pending.

emergencyWithdraw().notice: Emergency withdraw: recover staked principal immediately, forfeiting pending rewards.         Works even when the contract is paused — users are never locked out of principal.

pause().notice: Pause staking and claiming. emergencyWithdraw remains available.

rewardPerToken().notice: Global reward-per-token accumulator including time elapsed since last update.

stake(uint256).notice: Stake APX. Rewards start accruing immediately.

stakerCount().notice: Number of unique addresses that have ever staked.

startCooldown().notice: Begin the 7-day unstake cooldown for the caller's full stake.         Reward accrual stops immediately — cooldown position earns nothing.

unstake().notice: Withdraw staked APX after the cooldown period has elapsed.
